inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if DCAI growth reverses, custom accelerators materially displace Xeon attachment, or 18A, 14A and packaging demand fail to produce material durable revenue and cash returns.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: AI-infrastructure demand can raise Intel economics through Xeon server CPUs, Ethernet, advanced packaging, foundry wafers and purpose-built silicon, while offering-funded 18A and 14A investment expands capacity for that demand.

objective: Review whether Intel has a material causal relationship to AI compute and networking monetization through Xeon server CPUs, Ethernet, advanced packaging, foundry wafers and purpose-built silicon; accept or reject the edge.
